hints: The queue is already sorted. What does that tell you about the heaviest parcel and whether it can pair with anything?
Look at the lightest and the heaviest at the same time. If even those two are over the limit, the heaviest cannot pair with anyone.
Put one pointer at each end. When the two ends fit, every parcel between them also fits with the lighter one - count them all at once.
While low < high: if weights[low] + weights[high] <= limit, add high - low to the count and advance low; otherwise step high back. Each pointer moves at most n times.
